headline: Approved moving Oktoberfest to October 24, 2026, under a temporary mass gathering permit amendment.
summary: The permit amendment was requested by John Brito, the owner of Birch and Bay. Approval depends on Rhode Island Department of Transportation approval to close Main Street, plus a hold harmless agreement and an insurance certificate. The vote was unanimous.
decisions: Approved, by unanimous vote, an amendment moving Oktoberfest to October 24, 2026.

decision_titles: Oktoberfest temporary mass gathering permit amendment, TMG-26-8
plain_text:
REGULAR SESSION 
 
OCTOBER 22, 2026 
 
 
REGULAR SESSION of the Town Council of the Town of South Kingstown, County of Washington, in the State of 
Rhode Island held at the Town Hall, in and for said Town on the 22nd day of October 2026 at 7:00 PM. 
 
 PRESENT: Rory H. McEntee, President  
Michael K. Marran, Vice President 
Patricia A. Alley 
Jay G. Wegimont 
 
1. REGULAR SESSION  
 
A. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE TO THE FLAG 
 
The Pledge of Allegiance to the flag is given. 
 
B. LAND ACKNOWLEDGEMENT STATEMENT  
 
The Land Acknowledgement Statement is read. 
 
2. ROLL CALL 
 
Roll Call is taken. Council Member Bergner is not present.                
 
3. LICENSES:  
 
A. Council President McEntee introduces an amendment of a Temporary Mass Gathering Permit to John Brito to 
change the date of Oktoberfest from October 17, 2026, to October 24, 2026. 
 
John Brito is present and after testimony and discussion it is  
 
UNANIMOUSLY VOTED: to authorize an amendment of a Temporary Mass Gathering Permit, originally granted 
September 28, 2026, to change the date of Oktoberfest from October 17, 2026 to October 24, 2026, from 11:00 
am to 11:00 pm at Birch and Bay, 323 Main Street, Wakefield, RI 02879 and on Main Street between Robinson 
Street and Kenyon Avenue, subject to RI Department of Transportation approval for the closure of Main Street 
and stipulations set by the Police Department and Building Official, and the execution of a hold harmless 
agreement indemnifying the Town and receipt of a Certificate of Insurance naming the Town as an additional 
insured for the event in the amounts specified by the Finance Director. Application by John Brito, Owner. License 
No. TMG-26-8. 
 
Discussion ensues regarding Rhode Island Department of Transportation (RIDOT) approvals and the event 
schedule. 
 
4. PUBLIC COMMENTS 
 
Council President McEntee invites residents to come forward with comments. 
 
There being no comments it is 
 
 UNANIMOUSLY VOTED: to adjourn at 7:06 PM. 
 
Emily Houle  
Town Clerk
